propositions: binding_store.py exceeds 800 lines and couples file loading, JSON encoding, rotation ordering, retired-state replacement, and alert persistence with identity policy, creating risk of silent data loss during refactoring

BindingRepository must be extracted as a private unit-of-work owning paths and original dictionaries while preserving every existing load/save byte contract and exception behavior behind an unchanged public BindingStore facade

Repository must preserve rotation-before-live order, retired-first move ordering, best-effort alert writes, and exact sorted/indented/newline serialization without introducing multi-file atomicity claims

Load/save round trips must be byte-equal for legacy records with unknown fields, and each named fault injection must yield the same surviving file combination and raise/swallow/alert behavior as before extraction
GET rotation durability and tickets publication seam to reconcile_helpers.py must remain unchanged, with no format migration, eager rewrite, or broad staging introduced
